# Third-party HTTP/JSON infrastructure (M1)

Antigravity should obtain pinned, license-respecting releases of:
- cpp-httplib — https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib
- nlohmann/json — https://github.com/nlohmann/json

Keep versions and license files in this folder, and review dependencies.
These are for HTTP/JSON, not for replacing required custom DS or algorithms.
Do not rely on CMake FetchContent downloads when demo laptops are offline.
